job.job_description:
Opening with one of the leading IT consulting firm




Role: Agentic AI Engineer

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)
Experience: 6-12 Years




Role Overview




We are looking for an experienced AI professional to design and build enterprise AI applications powered by LLMs, agentic workflows, and AI orchestration frameworks.




Key Responsibilities



Develop AI-powered applications using Azure OpenAI, GPT, and related technologies.
Design agentic workflows including intent classification, tool orchestration, and multi-step actions.
Build prompt engineering, context management, and response optimization frameworks.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and Microsoft Graph.
Implement MCP-based tool calling, human-in-the-loop approvals, and secure AI actions.
Develop validation, fallback, and error-handling mechanisms for AI workflows.



Required Skills



Experience building LLM-based applications (Azure OpenAI, GPT, etc.).
Strong understanding of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and workflow orchestration.
Experience with enterprise API integrations (CRM, ERP, Microsoft Graph API).
Knowledge of RBAC, AI governance, and secure execution models.



Preferred Skills

Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar agent frameworks.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-based architectures.
Outlook, Teams, and multi-channel AI integrations.
Experience with AI response validation and human-in-the-loop workflows.



Skills: Generative AI, LLM, Azure OpenAI, GPT, Agentic AI, MCP, Copilot Studio, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, Microsoft Graph API, Enterprise AI.




If interested share update CV at dhara@thepremierconsultants.com
